title: Orb and tall glowing figure filmed at a healing for a cancer patient

tellings.quote: All of a sudden in the video, you'll see an orb appear. It comes zooming right up to me

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a North Carolina man who says he has seen glowing balls of light called orbs for years, says that sometime between 2013 and 2015 he was filmed at his home during a healing for a cancer patient. He says the video shows an orb appear and zoom right up to him, along with a tall glowing figure, which he tells on Jesse Michels's podcast as a sign that something beyond us was present.
